outcome: The Experiment workspace's labels and sharing rules now have real behaviour tests
owner_impact: Nothing changes on screen. The rules behind these workspace labels now live in one small module with 8 tests. They cover: who made a revision (Mine, Human, or the AI's name), where an Experiment lives (your collection, Shared with me, or a supervised student), who you can still share with, the 'library is ready' summary, and the 'new revision is available' notice. This is slice 2 of 5 of #554 (splitting the Experiment workspace module). Test now: optional quick look. Sign in, open one of your Experiments and check the revision history and the Share control. They should look and behave as before.

next.text: #554 continues with slice 3 of 5: the workspace status rules (the save-state text, the explanatory note, and which of Save / Save as new / Move / Share / Edit from revision / Discard appear). They move into a tested module. Nothing changes on screen.

technical_evidence: New web/src/registry/labels.js (pure): revision actor and AI client names, revision time, collection and location labels, share visibility and recipients, library summary, new-revision notice.
registry-ui-v3.js delegates to it via thin wrappers (call sites unchanged), 1,944 → 1,889 lines. Removed three unused helpers (roleLabel, profileForHumanOwner, revisionBelongsToMine).
New web/tests/registry-labels.test.mjs: 8 behaviour tests. Three planted rule changes (every person shown as Mine, non-owners seeing shares, supervised counts for non-Professors) are each caught.
Retired only the 15 source-text assertions (7 test files) whose behaviour the new tests cover, replaced by checks that the workspace uses the rules. 627 tests pass.
Style comparison of the built Lab identical to the slice 1 build at all four viewports.
